question: Which Lumen project used the most tokens in the week starting 2026-10-17?
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE bucket >= '2026-10-17T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-10-24T00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In the week starting 2026-11-07, which support-triage tool had the higher p95 latency: fetch_ticket or search_kb?
reference_sql: SELECT tool FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.name = 'support-triage' AND tool IN ('fetch_ticket', 'search_kb') AND bucket >= '2026-11-07T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-11-14T00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(latency_hist[7] + latency_hist[8] + latency_hist[9] + latency_hist[10] + latency_hist[11] + latency_hist[12] + latency_hist[13])::float / sum(calls) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which model did support-triage use on 2026-11-04?
reference_sql: SELECT model FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.name = 'support-triage' AND model <> '' AND bucket >= '2026-11-04T08:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-11-05T08:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(calls) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which prompt version of order-lookup did checkout-assistant mostly run on 2026-10-19?
